run_singlepoint_calculations: run single point energy and force calculations on a batch of atomic structures using an ASE calculator
calculate_chunked_structures: calculate properties on a subset of structures by splitting input data into parallel job chunks
write_results_to_json: write singlepoint calculation results as a compressed JSON file to a specified output directory
initialize_singlepoint_runner: initialize a SinglePointRunner with an ASE calculator, input atoms data, and properties to calculate
save_checkpoint_state: save the checkpoint state of a SinglePointRunner calculation for preemption recovery
